guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 使用 USDC 为 Solana 钱包充值
guide.description: Huma 2.0 在 Solana 的 USDC 结算，因此你需要在 Solana 钱包（如 Phantom 或 Solflare）中进行结算。你可以在 Binance 上购买 USDC 和 SOL，然后提现到你的钱包，或者使用下面的跨链组件跨链转移现有资金。保留少量 SOL 以支付交易费用。Bridge 资金交换和跨 30 多条链跨链，无需离开此页面。路线快捷，费用低廉。 立即跨链打开交互式跨链组件在新标签页中打开跨链
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Fund a Solana Wallet with USDC
guide.original_description: Huma 2.0 settles in USDC on Solana, so you will need both in a Solana wallet such as Phantom or Solflare. You can buy USDC and SOL on Binance and withdraw to your wallet, or move existing funds across chains using the bridge widget below. Keep a small amount of SOL on hand for transaction fees. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge

guide.title: 将你的钱包连接到 Huma 应用
guide.description: 打开官方 Huma Finance 应用并连接你的 Solana 钱包。Huma 2.0 无需许可，无需 KYC，因此连接后你可以直接存款。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect Your Wallet to the Huma App
guide.original_description: Open the official Huma Finance application and connect your Solana wallet. Huma 2.0 is permissionless and requires no KYC, so you can move straight to depositing once connected.

guide.title: 选择你的耕作策略
guide.description: 打开存款部分并选择适合你目标的模式： 经典：赚取实际收益率（年利率约 10.5%，每月更新）加上基本利率 Feathers。如果你想要回报和空投积分，这是最好的选择。 Maxi：赚取 0% APY，但产生高达经典模式 5 倍的 Feathers。如果你纯粹针对分配进行优化，则最好。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the Deposit section and pick the mode that fits your goal: Classic : Earns real yield (around 10.5% APY, updated monthly) plus a base rate of Feathers. Best if you want returns alongside airdrop points. Maxi : Earns 0% APY but generates up to 5x the Feathers of Classic mode. Best if you are optimizing purely for allocation.

guide.title: 存入 USDC 并接收 PST
guide.description: 输入你的存款金额并确认交易。作为回报，你会收到 $PST，这是一种流动的 LP 代币，代表你的头寸并自动累积 Feathers。你可以在 Jupiter 或 Meteora 等 Solana 场所将 $PST 兑换回 USDC 退出，不过提前平仓会减少你积累的 Feathers。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Enter your deposit amount and confirm the transaction. In return you receive $PST, a liquid LP token that represents your position and accrues Feathers automatically. You can swap $PST back to USDC on Solana venues like Jupiter or Meteora to exit, though unwinding early reduces the Feathers you accumulate.

guide.title: 锁定你的位置以获得奖金 Feathers
guide.description: 此步骤是可选的。将你的存款存入固定的 3 个月或 6 个月锁定期，将使你在此期间赚取的 Feathers 成倍增加。仅锁定你愿意保留的资本，因为锁定头寸在期限结束之前无法撤回。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Lock Your Position for Bonus Feathers
guide.original_description: This step is optional. Committing your deposit to a fixed 3-month or 6-month lock multiplies the Feathers you earn over that period. Only lock capital you are comfortable leaving in place, since locked positions cannot be withdrawn until the term ends.

guide.title: 质押 HUMA 额外 Feathers
guide.description: 如果你持有 HUMA，在 LP 奖励之外，质押它还可以获得额外的 Feathers 奖励，没有固定锁定。在质押时持有 $PST 会进一步提升，将代币质押六个月可解锁 Vanguard 状态。随时取消质押。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: If you hold HUMA, staking it earns additional Feathers on top of your LP rewards, with no fixed lockup. Holding $PST while staking adds a further boost, and keeping tokens staked for six months unlocks Vanguard status. Unstake any time.

guide.title: 查看资格和领取
guide.description: 如果你在完成的季节耕种，请前往资格检查器，连接你的钱包，然后在 Solana 上领取你的 HUMA。第 4 季跳棋现已上线。在下一轮中，继续在 Huma 应用中监控你的 Feathers 余额，并在拍摄快照并打开窗口后再次领取。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: If you farmed in a completed season, head to the eligibility checker , connect your wallet, and claim your HUMA on Solana. The Season 4 checker is live now. For the next round, keep monitoring your Feathers balance in the Huma app and claim again once its snapshot is taken and the window opens.

存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
